power.method: 5000mAh rechargeable battery; charged via base station

storage.notes: Records to external USB storage on the E1 base station; Foscam Cloud (up to 1GB free).

features: base station with external USB storage

frigate.notes: Wire-free battery camera paired with a base station; no documented local ONVIF/RTSP path (network protocols listed are IP/TCP/UDP/HTTP/HTTPS/DHCP only). Only usable in Frigate if the vendor exposes a stream.

home_assistant.notes: App/cloud + base-station managed; add via Generic Camera only if a local stream is exposed.

blue_iris.notes: No confirmed local RTSP path (app/base-station managed).
